        # release: smooth + short lp
        y=_smooth(y,iters=120,T0=0.008,T1=0.0008,lr0=0.008,lr1=0.002)
        y=_lp_polish(y,seconds=1.2,r0=1.5e-3)
        v=_max_cos(y)
        Gy=y@y.T; cy=Gy[iu0]; Ey=_edge_set(cy,v,tol=1e-5)
        inter=len(Ey & E0); union=len(Ey | E0)
        ov=inter/max(union,1)
        pool.append((v,y.copy(),ov))
        if v<best_val-1e-12:

            best=y.copy(); best_val=v

            E0=Ey
            # recompute duals for remaining jobs? keep old to save time, but update mref
            mref=best_val
        elif ov<0.88:

            pass
        # Metropolis-like: if close, maybe keep as base for next? no, always from best
    # second round on most diverse promising candidates
    pool_sorted=sorted(pool,key=lambda t:t[0])
    # pick up to 2 diverse with ov<0.85 and value within 5e-3 of best
    second=[]
    for v,y,ov in pool_sorted:
        if ov<0.85 and v<best_val+5e-3 and len(second)<2:
            second.append((v,y))
    for v0,y0 in second:
        if time.time()-t0>BUDGET-18:
            break
        # new dual at y0
        di2=_dual_info(y0,radius=1e-3)
        if di2 is None:
            continue
        I2,J2,w2=di2["I"],di2["J"],di2["w"]
        o2=np.argsort(-w2)
        for delta in [1e-3]:
            if time.time()-t0>BUDGET-14:
                break
            k=min(28,len(o2))
            FI=I2[o2[:k]]; FJ=J2[o2[:k]]
            lo=np.minimum(FI,FJ); hi=np.maximum(FI,FJ)
            FI,FJ=lo,hi
            y=y0.copy()
            y=_forced_phase(y,FI,FJ,delta,mref=v0,radius=0.015,iters=4)
            y=_smooth(y,iters=100,T0=0.006,T1=0.0008,lr0=0.007,lr1=0.002)
            y=_lp_polish(y,seconds=1.0,r0=1.5e-3)
            v=_max_cos(y)
            if v<best_val:
                best=y.copy(); best_val=v
    # final thorough polish of best with remaining time
    remain=BUDGET-(time.time()-t0)
    if remain>4:
        # alternate smooth + lp
        best=_smooth(best,iters=150,T0=0.004,T1=0.0005,lr0=0.005,lr1=0.001)
        best=_lp_polish(best,seconds=max(2.0,remain-2.0))
        best_val=_max_cos(best)
    best=best/np.linalg.norm(best,axis=1,keepdims=True)
    return best

idea: Dual-guided contact surgery forcing the most-stressed active pairs below max-delta then re-polishing to change basin topology.
direction: Perform dual-guided contact-graph surgery rather than random shaking: solve the final trust-region LP at the record, extract its dual variables or marginals for the active pairs, and identify the most stressed contacts and points, then run a constrained reoptimization in which 20–40 selected active pairs are forced to have cosine at most $\text{current max}-\delta$ for $\delta\in[5\times10^{-4},2\times10^{-3}]$, temporarily accepting an increase in other pairs before removing the forcing terms and LP-polishing. Repeat with different stressed clusters—highest-dual edges, high-degree points, and spatially localized patches—and keep candidates whose contact graph at a $10^{-5}$ threshold differs substantially, since a genuinely new topology is more promising than another nearly identical local optimum.

import time
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import linprog
from scipy.sparse import coo_matrix

def _max_cos(x):
    g = x @ x.T
    np.fill_diagonal(g, -2.0)
    return float(g.max())

def _contacts(x, thr):
    G = x @ x.T
    np.fill_diagonal(G, -2.0)
    m = float(G.max())
    iu = np.triu_indices(x.shape[0], 1)
    c = G[iu]
    sel = c > m - thr
    return iu[0][sel], iu[1][sel], c[sel], m

def _lp_polish(x, seconds, t_end, r0=2e-3):
    x = x / np.linalg.norm(x, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    n, d = x.shape
    best = _max_cos(x)
    radius = r0
    iu = np.triu_indices(n, 1)
    start = time.time()
    while time.time() - start < seconds and time.time() < t_end:
        if radius < 1e-14:
            break
        G = x @ x.T
        c_all = G[iu]
        m = float(c_all.max())
        window = max(20.0 * radius, 1e-9)
        sel = c_all > (m - window)
        cnt = int(np.count_nonzero(sel))
        if cnt == 0:
            break
        if cnt > 2200:
            idx = np.argpartition(c_all, -2200)[-2200:]
            sel = np.zeros_like(sel, dtype=bool)
            sel[idx] = True
        I = iu[0][sel]; J = iu[1][sel]
        c = c_all[sel]
        p = len(I)
        nv = n * d + 1
        rows = np.repeat(np.arange(p), 2 * d + 1)
        cols = np.concatenate([I[:, None]*d + np.arange(d), J[:, None]*d + np.arange(d), np.full((p,1), n*d)], axis=1).ravel()
        vals = np.concatenate([x[J], x[I], -np.ones((p,1))], axis=1).ravel()
        A_ub = coo_matrix((vals, (rows, cols)), shape=(p, nv)).tocsr()
        A_eq = coo_matrix((x.ravel(), (np.repeat(np.arange(n), d), np.arange(n*d))), shape=(n, nv)).tocsr()
        obj = np.zeros(nv); obj[-1] = 1.0
        try:
            res = linprog(obj, A_ub=A_ub, b_ub=-c, A_eq=A_eq, b_eq=np.zeros(n),
                          bounds=[(-radius, radius)]*(n*d)+[(None,None)], method="highs",
                          options={"time_limit": 1.5})
        except Exception:
            radius *= 0.5
            continue
        if res.status != 0:
            radius *= 0.5
            continue
        y = x + res.x[:-1].reshape(n, d)
        y /= np.linalg.norm(y, axis=1, keepdims=True)
        v = _max_cos(y)
        if v < best:
            x, best = y, v
            radius = min(radius*1.6, 0.05)
        else:
            radius *= 0.5
    return x, best

def _lp_duals(x, radius=1e-3, window=None):
    n, d = x.shape
    iu = np.triu_indices(n, 1)
    G = x @ x.T
    c_all = G[iu]
    m = float(c_all.max())
    if window is None:
        window = max(20.0*radius, 2e-4)
    sel = c_all > (m - window)
    cnt = int(np.count_nonzero(sel))
    if cnt > 2500:
        idx = np.argpartition(c_all, -2500)[-2500:]
        sel = np.zeros_like(sel, dtype=bool)
        sel[idx] = True
    I = iu[0][sel]; J = iu[1][sel]
    c = c_all[sel]
    p = len(I)

    cols = np.concatenate([I[:,None]*d+np.arange(d), J[:,None]*d+np.arange(d), np.full((p,1), n*d)], axis=1).ravel()
    vals = np.concatenate([x[J], x[I], -np.ones((p,1))], axis=1).ravel()
    A_ub = coo_matrix((vals,(rows,cols)), shape=(p,nv)).tocsr()
    A_eq = coo_matrix((x.ravel(),(np.repeat(np.arange(n),d),np.arange(n*d))), shape=(n,nv)).tocsr()
    obj = np.zeros(nv); obj[-1]=1.0
    try:
        res = linprog(obj, A_ub=A_ub, b_ub=-c, A_eq=A_eq, b_eq=np.zeros(n),
                      bounds=[(-radius,radius)]*(n*d)+[(None,None)], method="highs",
                      options={"time_limit": 3.0})
    except Exception:
        return I, J, c, m, None, False
    if res.status != 0:
        return I, J, c, m, None, False
    duals = None
    try:

        except Exception:

        # simpler: build per row

        top = np.concatenate([x[JJ], x[II]], axis=1) if False else None
        # x[J] for first block = x[other]
        v1 = x[JJ]
        v2 = x[II]
        vlast = np.concatenate([-np.ones((pf,1)), np.zeros((pp,1))], axis=0) if p>0 else np.zeros((0,1))
        vals = np.concatenate([v1, v2, vlast], axis=1).ravel()
        A_ub = coo_matrix((vals,(rows,cols)), shape=(p,nv)).tocsr()
        b_ub = np.concatenate([-cf, target - c_forced_cur]) if p>0 else np.zeros(0)
        A_eq = coo_matrix((x.ravel(),(np.repeat(np.arange(n),d),np.arange(n*d))), shape=(n,nv)).tocsr()
        obj = np.zeros(nv); obj[-1]=1.0
        try:
            res = linprog(obj, A_ub=A_ub, b_ub=b_ub, A_eq=A_eq, b_eq=np.zeros(n),
                          bounds=[(-radius,radius)]*(n*d)+[(None,None)], method="highs",
                          options={"time_limit": 1.5})
        except Exception:
            radius *= 0.5
            continue
        if res.status != 0:
            # infeasible -> relax: shrink delta effect by raising target slightly or shrink radius
            radius *= 0.5
            if radius < 1e-5:
                break
            continue
        y = x + res.x[:-1].reshape(n,d)
        y /= np.linalg.norm(y, axis=1, keepdims=True)
        Gy = y @ y.T
        np.fill_diagonal(Gy, -2.0)
        forced_new = float(Gy[FI,FJ].max()) if pp>0 else -2.0
        forced_old = float(c_forced_cur.max()) if pp>0 else -2.0
        if forced_new < forced_old - 1e-12:
            x = y
            radius = min(radius*1.25, 0.04)
        else:
            # accept if not worse much? to keep moving
            if forced_new <= forced_old + 1e-9:
                x = y
            radius *= 0.6
        if radius < 1e-6:
            break
    return x

def _edge_set(x, thr=1e-5):
    G = x @ x.T
    np.fill_diagonal(G, -2.0)
    m = float(G.max())
    iu = np.triu_indices(x.shape[0], 1)
    sel = G[iu] > m - thr
    s = set(zip(iu[0][sel].tolist(), iu[1][sel].tolist()))
    return s

def solve():
    t0 = time.time()

    rng0 = np.random.RandomState(0)

    n, d = 163, 4

    aduals = np.abs(duals)

    pstress = np.zeros(n)

    # degrees at 1e-9

    deg = np.zeros(n, dtype=int)

    # build clusters (each is (FI,FJ))

    top_pts = np.argsort(-pstress)[:8]

    idx = np.where(mask)[0]

        Gs = seed_x @ seed_x.T
        cfilt = Gs[FI, FJ]
        keep = cfilt > (seed_max - 0.005)
        if int(np.count_nonzero(keep)) >= 12:

        v_f = _max_cos(x_f)

        # polish without forcing

        budget = min(budget, T_END-4.0-time.time())
        if budget < 0.6:

        x_p, v_p = _lp_polish(x_f, budget, T_END-2.0, r0=2e-3)
        # diversity check
        es = _edge_set(x_p, thr=1e-5)
        inter = len(es & base_edge_set)
        union = len(es | base_edge_set)
        jac = inter/max(union,1)
        # update pool with diverse near-best
        if v_p < best_v:
            best_v = float(v_p); best_x = x_p.copy()
            base_edge_set = _edge_set(best_x, thr=1e-5)
            pool.insert(0, (best_x.copy(), best_v))
            pool = pool[:4]
        elif jac < 0.85 and v_p < seed_v + 0.003:
            # keep diverse candidate
            pool.append((x_p.copy(), float(v_p)))
            # keep pool small, sort by v
            pool = sorted(pool, key=lambda t: t[1])[:4]
            # also if diverse and close, try extra polish later (handled by seeding)
        ci += 1
    # final polish best
    if time.time() < T_END - 2.0:
        sec = max(0.5, min(8.0, T_END-1.5-time.time()))
        best_x, best_v = _lp_polish(best_x, sec, T_END-0.8, r0=2e-3)
    best_x = best_x / np.linalg.norm(best_x, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    return best_x

idea: Dual-stress forced surgery with short annealed repulsion and trust-region LP polishing across rotating high-dual, high-degree and patch clusters to jump contact-graph basins.
direction: Perform dual-guided contact-graph surgery rather than random shaking: solve the final trust-region LP at the record, extract its dual variables or marginals for the active pairs, and identify the most stressed contacts and points, then run a constrained reoptimization in which 20–40 selected active pairs are forced to have cosine at most $\text{current max}-\delta$ for $\delta\in[5\times10^{-4},2\times10^{-3}]$, temporarily accepting an increase in other pairs before removing the forcing terms and LP-polishing. Repeat with different stressed clusters—highest-dual edges, high-degree points, and spatially localized patches—and keep candidates whose contact graph at a $10^{-5}$ threshold differs substantially, since a genuinely new topology is more promising than another nearly identical local optimum.

import time
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import linprog
from scipy.sparse import coo_matrix

def _max_cos(x):
    g = x @ x.T
    np.fill_diagonal(g, -2.0)
    return float(np.max(g))

def _lp_polish(x, seconds, r0=2e-3, cap=1600):
    x = x / np.linalg.norm(x, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    n, d = x.shape
    best = _max_cos(x)
    radius = r0
    start = time.time()
    iu0 = np.triu_indices(n, 1)
    while time.time() - start < seconds and radius > 1e-14:
        G = x @ x.T
        c_all = G[iu0]
        m = float(c_all.max())
        thr = m - max(20.0 * radius, 1e-9)
        sel = c_all > thr
        cnt = int(np.count_nonzero(sel))
        if cnt == 0:
            break
        if cnt > cap:
            v = c_all[sel]
            kth = np.sort(v)[-cap]
            sel = c_all >= kth
            cnt2 = int(np.count_nonzero(sel))
            if cnt2 > cap + 600:
                ids = np.where(sel)[0]
                keep = ids[::2][:cap]
                ns = np.zeros_like(sel)
                ns[keep] = True
                sel = ns
        I = iu0[0][sel]; J = iu0[1][sel]
        c = c_all[sel]
        p = len(I)
        nv = n * d + 1
        rows = np.repeat(np.arange(p), 2 * d + 1)
        cd = np.arange(d)
        cols = np.concatenate([I[:, None]*d+cd, J[:, None]*d+cd, np.full((p,1), n*d)], 1).ravel()
        vals = np.concatenate([x[J], x[I], -np.ones((p,1))], 1).ravel()
        A_ub = coo_matrix((vals, (rows, cols)), shape=(p, nv)).tocsr()
        A_eq = coo_matrix((x.ravel(), (np.repeat(np.arange(n), d), np.arange(n*d))), shape=(n, nv)).tocsr()
        obj = np.zeros(nv); obj[-1] = 1.0
        try:
            res = linprog(obj, A_ub=A_ub, b_ub=-c, A_eq=A_eq, b_eq=np.zeros(n),
                          bounds=[(-radius, radius)]*(n*d)+[(None,None)], method="highs")
        except Exception:
            radius *= 0.5
            continue
        if res.status != 0:
            radius *= 0.5
            continue
        y = x + res.x[:-1].reshape(n, d)
        y /= np.linalg.norm(y, axis=1, keepdims=True)
        v = _max_cos(y)
        if v < best:
            x, best = y, v
            radius = min(radius*1.6, 0.05)
        else:
            radius *= 0.5
    return x

def _lp_duals(x, radius=1.5e-3, cap=1800):
    n, d = x.shape
    iu0 = np.triu_indices(n, 1)
    G = x @ x.T
    c_all = G[iu0]
    m = float(c_all.max())
    thr = m - max(20.0*radius, 1e-9)
    sel = c_all > thr
    if int(np.count_nonzero(sel)) > cap:
        v = c_all[sel]
        kth = np.sort(v)[-cap]
        sel = c_all >= kth
    I = iu0[0][sel]; J = iu0[1][sel]
    c = c_all[sel]
    p = len(I)
    nv = n*d+1
    rows = np.repeat(np.arange(p), 2*d+1)
    cd = np.arange(d)
    cols = np.concatenate([I[:,None]*d+cd, J[:,None]*d+cd, np.full((p,1), n*d)], 1).ravel()
    vals = np.concatenate([x[J], x[I], -np.ones((p,1))], 1).ravel()
    A_ub = coo_matrix((vals,(rows,cols)), shape=(p,nv)).tocsr()
    A_eq = coo_matrix((x.ravel(), (np.repeat(np.arange(n),d), np.arange(n*d))), shape=(n,nv)).tocsr()
    obj = np.zeros(nv); obj[-1]=1.0
    try:
        res = linprog(obj, A_ub=A_ub, b_ub=-c, A_eq=A_eq, b_eq=np.zeros(n),
                      bounds=[(-radius,radius)]*(n*d)+[(None,None)], method="highs")
    except Exception:
        return I, J, np.ones(len(I)), m
    if res.status != 0:
        return I, J, np.ones(len(I)), m
    dual = None
    try:
        if hasattr(res, 'ineqlin') and res.ineqlin is not None:
            mg = None
            if isinstance(res.ineqlin, dict):
                mg = res.ineqlin.get('marginals', None)
            else:
                mg = getattr(res.ineqlin, 'marginals', None)
            if mg is not None:
                dual = np.asarray(mg, dtype=float).ravel()
    except Exception:
        dual = None
    if dual is None or dual.shape[0] != p:
        dual = np.ones(p)
    dual = np.abs(np.asarray(dual, dtype=float).ravel())
    if dual.shape[0] != p or np.max(dual) < 1e-12 or not np.all(np.isfinite(dual)):
        dual = np.ones(p)
    return I, J, dual, m

def _smooth_forced(x, forced_set, m0, delta, iters, T, lr, boost=20.0, allow=0.004):
    n, d = x.shape
    F = np.zeros((n, n), dtype=bool)
    for (a,b) in forced_set:
        F[a,b] = True; F[b,a] = True
    hasF = len(forced_set) > 0
    for k in range(iters):
        frac = k / max(iters-1, 1)
        Tk = T * (0.6 + 0.4*(1.0-frac))
        lrk = lr * (1.0 - 0.5*frac)
        G = x @ x.T
        np.fill_diagonal(G, -2.0)
        W = np.exp((G - (m0+allow)) / Tk)
        np.fill_diagonal(W, 0.0)
        if hasF:
            Wf = np.exp((G - (m0-delta)) / (Tk*0.7)) * 1.0) * boost
            W = np.where(F, Wf, W)
            np.fill_diagonal(W, 0.0)
        grad = W @ x
        dot = np.sum(grad*x, axis=1, keepdims=True)
        gt = grad - dot*x
        rs = W.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
        step = gt / np.maximum(rs, 1e-12)
        sn = np.linalg.norm(step, axis=1, keepdims=True)
        step = step / np.maximum(sn, 1.0)
        x = x - lrk*step
        x /= np.linalg.norm(x, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    return x

def _smooth_plain(x, iters, T0, T1, lr0, lr1):
    for k in range(iters):
        frac = k / max(iters-1, 1)
        T = T0*(T1/T0)**frac
        lr = lr0*(lr1/lr0)**frac
        G = x @ x.T
        np.fill_diagonal(G, -2.0)
        m = float(G.max())
        W = np.exp((G-m)/T)
        np.fill_diagonal(W, 0.0)
        grad = W @ x
        dot = np.sum(grad*x, axis=1, keepdims=True)
        gt = grad - dot*x
        rs = W.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
        step = gt/np.maximum(rs,1e-12)
        sn = np.linalg.norm(step, axis=1, keepdims=True)
        step = step/np.maximum(sn,1.0)
        x = x - lr*step
        x /= np.linalg.norm(x, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    return x

def solve():

import time
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import linprog
from scipy.sparse import coo_matrix

def _max_cos(x):
    g = x @ x.T
    np.fill_diagonal(g, -2.0)
    return float(np.max(g))

def _contacts(x, tol=2e-7):
    n = x.shape[0]
    G = x @ x.T
    np.fill_diagonal(G, -2.0)
    m = float(G.max())
    rm = G.max(axis=1)
    cnt = (G >= m - tol).sum(axis=1)
    return m, rm, cnt, G

def _lp_polish(x, seconds, r0=2e-3, cap=2000):
    x = x / np.linalg.norm(x, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    n, d = x.shape
    best = _max_cos(x)
    radius = r0
    start = time.time()
    iu = np.triu_indices(n, 1)
    while time.time() - start < seconds and radius > 1e-14:
        G = x @ x.T
        c_all = G[iu]
        m = float(c_all.max())
        thr = m - max(20.0 * radius, 1e-9)
        sel = c_all > thr
        if int(np.count_nonzero(sel)) == 0:
            break
        if int(np.count_nonzero(sel)) > cap:
            v = c_all[sel]
            kth = np.sort(v)[-cap]
            sel = c_all >= kth
            if int(np.count_nonzero(sel)) > cap + 600:
                ids = np.where(sel)[0][::2][:cap]
                ns = np.zeros_like(sel)
                ns[ids] = True
                sel = ns
        I = iu[0][sel]; J = iu[1][sel]
        c = c_all[sel]
        p = len(I)
        nv = n * d + 1
        rows = np.repeat(np.arange(p), 2 * d + 1)
        cd = np.arange(d)
        cols = np.concatenate([I[:, None]*d+cd, J[:, None]*d+cd, np.full((p,1), n*d)], 1).ravel()
        vals = np.concatenate([x[J], x[I], -np.ones((p,1))], 1).ravel()
        A_ub = coo_matrix((vals, (rows, cols)), shape=(p, nv)).tocsr()
        A_eq = coo_matrix((x.ravel(), (np.repeat(np.arange(n), d), np.arange(n*d))), shape=(n, nv)).tocsr()
        obj = np.zeros(nv); obj[-1] = 1.0
        try:
            res = linprog(obj, A_ub=A_ub, b_ub=-c, A_eq=A_eq, b_eq=np.zeros(n),
                          bounds=[(-radius, radius)]*(n*d)+[(None,None)], method="highs")
        except Exception:
            radius *= 0.5
            continue
        if res.status != 0:
            radius *= 0.5
            continue
        y = x + res.x[:-1].reshape(n, d)
        y /= np.linalg.norm(y, axis=1, keepdims=True)
        v = _max_cos(y)
        if v < best:
            x, best = y, v
            radius = min(radius*1.6, 0.05)
        else:
            radius *= 0.5
    return x

def _smooth(x, iters, T0, T1, lr0, lr1):
    n, d = x.shape
    for k in range(iters):
        frac = k / max(iters-1, 1)
        T = T0*(T1/T0)**frac
        lr = lr0*(lr1/lr0)**frac
        G = x @ x.T
        np.fill_diagonal(G, -2.0)
        m = float(G.max())
        W = np.exp((G-m)/T)
        np.fill_diagonal(W, 0.0)
        grad = W @ x
        dot = np.sum(grad*x, axis=1, keepdims=True)
        gt = grad - dot*x
        rs = W.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
        step = gt/np.maximum(rs, 1e-12)
        sn = np.linalg.norm(step, axis=1, keepdims=True)
        step = step/np.maximum(sn, 1.0)
        x = x - lr*step
        x /= np.linalg.norm(x, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    return x

def _void_points(x, n_need, rng, n_samp=4000):
    # sample sphere, keep farthest from x, refine slightly
    cand = rng.normal(size=(n_samp, 4))
    cand /= np.linalg.norm(cand, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    s = cand @ x.T
    sc = s.max(axis=1)
    order = np.argsort(sc)[:n_need*8]
    pool = cand[order]
    out = []
    for v0 in pool:
        v = v0.copy()
        for _ in range(15):
            dots = x @ v
            mm = dots.max()
            w = np.exp(50.0*(dots-mm))
            g = w @ x
            gt = g - np.dot(g, v)*v
            nrm = np.linalg.norm(gt)
            if nrm < 1e-12:
                break
            v = v - 0.12*gt/nrm
            v /= np.linalg.norm(v)
        out.append(v)
        if len(out) >= n_need*8:
            break
    out = np.array(out)
    sc2 = (out @ x.T).max(axis=1)
    idx = np.argsort(sc2)
    # greedy diverse pick
    sel = []
    for j in idx:
        if len(sel) >= n_need:
            break
        if len(sel)==0:
            sel.append(j)
        else:
            if np.max(out[sel] @ out[j]) < 0.95:
                sel.append(j)
    while len(sel) < n_need:
        sel.append(idx[len(sel)])
    return out[np.array(sel)]

def solve():

    BUDGET = 168.0
    rng = np.random.RandomState(0)

        x0 = np.load("best.npy").astype(float)

    n, d = x0.shape

    m, rm, cnt, G = _contacts(best_x)
    order_load = np.argsort(-cnt)  # overloaded first
    rattlers = np.where(cnt <= 1)[0]
    # main basin loop
    it = 0

    while time.time()-t0 < BUDGET-22:
        it += 1
        time_left = BUDGET-22-(time.time()-t0)
        if time_left <= 2:
            break
        y = best_x.copy()
        mode = it % 5
        # choose targets
        m2, rm2, cnt2, _ = _contacts(best_x) if (it % 3 == 1) else (m, rm, cnt, G)
        overload = order_load[:12]
        if mode == 0:
            # relocate rattlers/near-rattlers to voids
            k = 3
            # pick k worst-or-rattler indices
            cand_idx = list(rattlers[:4]) if len(rattlers)>0 else []
            # add most overloaded to diversify
            while len(cand_idx) < k:
                cand_idx.append(int(overload[rng.randint(len(overload))]))
            cand_idx = np.array(cand_idx[:k])
            keep_mask = np.ones(n, bool); keep_mask[cand_idx]=False
            voids = _void_points(y[keep_mask], k, rng, n_samp=3500)
            y[cand_idx] = voids[:len(cand_idx)]
            # small shake of neighbours of overloaded
            sig = 0.015
            nb = rng.randint(0, n, size=8)
            y[nb] += sig*rng.normal(size=(len(nb), d))
        elif mode == 1:
            # shake overloaded cluster + random
            idx = list(overload[rng.choice(len(overload), size=6, replace=False)])
            idx += list(rng.randint(0, n, size=10))
            idx = np.array(idx)

            Gc = best_x @ best_x.T
            np.fill_diagonal(Gc, -2.0)

            iu = np.triu_indices(n, 1)
            c = Gc[iu]
            top = np.argsort(-c)[:25]
            pts = np.unique(np.concatenate([iu[0][top], iu[1][top]]))
            sig = 0.035
            y[pts] += sig*rng.normal(size=(len(pts), d))
            # plus few random
            r = rng.randint(0, n, size=5)
            y[r] += 0.02*rng.normal(size=(5, d))
        else:
            # void relocate one + local shake
            k = 2
            worst = np.argsort(-rm2)[:6]
            cand_idx = rng.choice(worst, size=1, replace=False).tolist()
            if len(rattlers)>0 and rng.rand()<0.7:
                cand_idx.append(int(rattlers[rng.randint(len(rattlers))]))
            cand_idx = np.array(cand_idx[:k])
            keep_mask = np.ones(n, bool); keep_mask[cand_idx]=False
            voids = _void_points(y[keep_mask], len(cand_idx), rng, n_samp=3500)
            y[cand_idx] = voids
            y += 0.008*rng.normal(size=(n, d))

        v_s = _max_cos(y)

        y2 = _lp_polish(y, seconds=allow, r0=2e-3)

        if v2 < best_v - 1e-12:

    out = np.empty_like(pool)

import time
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import linprog
from scipy.sparse import coo_matrix

def _max_cos(x):
    g = x @ x.T
    np.fill_diagonal(g, -2.0)
    return float(np.max(g))

def _adam_smooth(x, iters, T0, T1, lr0, lr1, b1=0.9, b2=0.999, eps=1e-8):
    n, d = x.shape
    m = np.zeros_like(x)
    v = np.zeros_like(x)
    b1p = 1.0
    b2p = 1.0
    for k in range(iters):
        frac = k / max(iters - 1, 1)
        T = T0 * (T1 / T0) ** frac
        lr = lr0 * (lr1 / lr0) ** frac
        G = x @ x.T
        np.fill_diagonal(G, -2.0)
        mx = float(G.max())
        # softmax weights
        W = np.exp((G - mx) / T)
        np.fill_diagonal(W, 0.0)
        grad = W @ x
        dot = np.sum(grad * x, axis=1, keepdims=True)
        gt = grad - dot * x
        rs = W.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
        gt = gt / np.maximum(rs, 1e-12)
        b1p *= b1
        b2p *= b2
        m = b1 * m + (1.0 - b1) * gt
        v = b2 * v + (1.0 - b2) * (gt * gt)
        mh = m / (1.0 - b1p)
        vh = v / (1.0 - b2p)
        step = mh / (np.sqrt(vh) + eps)
        sdot = np.sum(step * x, axis=1, keepdims=True)
        st = step - sdot * x
        # clip large tangent steps
        sn = np.linalg.norm(st, axis=1, keepdims=True)
        st = st / np.maximum(sn, 1.0)
        x = x - lr * st
        x /= np.linalg.norm(x, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    return x

def _greedy_init(rng, N, pool_n=4000):
    pool = rng.normal(size=(pool_n, 4))
    pool /= np.linalg.norm(pool, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    first = int(rng.integers(pool_n))
    chosen = [first]
    is_chosen = np.zeros(pool_n, dtype=bool)
    is_chosen[first] = True
    # iterative farthest (min max-dot)
    for _ in range(1, N):
        c = pool[chosen]  # (k,4)
        dots = pool @ c.T
        md = dots.max(axis=1)
        md[is_chosen] = 1e9
        j = int(np.argmin(md))
        chosen.append(j)
        is_chosen[j] = True
    return pool[np.array(chosen)].copy()

def _best_void(x, rng, n_samp=4000, beta=60.0):
    base = x
    cand = rng.normal(size=(n_samp, 4))
    cand /= np.linalg.norm(cand, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    s = cand @ base.T
    sc = s.max(axis=1)
    order = np.argsort(sc)[:8]
    best_v = None
    best_s = 1e9
    for oi in order:
        v = cand[int(oi)].copy()
        for _ in range(30):
            dots = base @ v
            dm = float(dots.max())
            w = np.exp(beta * (dots - dm))
            g = w @ base
            gt = g - np.dot(g, v) * v
            nrm = float(np.linalg.norm(gt))
            if nrm < 1e-12:
                break
            gt /= nrm
            v = v - 0.08 * gt
            v /= np.linalg.norm(v)
        sc2 = float(np.max(base @ v))
        if sc2 < best_s:
            best_s = sc2
            best_v = v.copy()
    return best_v

def _delete_choice(x):
    n = x.shape[0]
    G = x @ x.T
    np.fill_diagonal(G, -2.0)
    iu0 = np.triu_indices(n, 1)
    c = G[iu0]
    K = min(40, c.shape[0])
    order = np.argpartition(-c, K - 1)[:K]
    # sort top K descending
    ov = c[order]
    o = np.argsort(-ov)
    order = order[o]
    TI = iu0[0][order]
    TJ = iu0[1][order]
    best_i = 0
    best_v = 1e9
    for i in range(n):
        val = None
        for k in range(K):
            if TI[k] != i and TJ[k] != i:
                val = float(c[order[k]])
                break
        if val is None:
            # fallback brute
            G2 = G.copy()
            G2[i, :] = -2.0
            G2[:, i] = -2.0
            val = float(G2.max())
        if val < best_v:
            best_v = val
            best_i = i
    return int(best_i)

def _lp_polish(x, seconds, r0=2e-3, cap=2200):
    x = x / np.linalg.norm(x, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    n, d = x.shape
    best = _max_cos(x)
    radius = r0
    start = time.time()
    iu0 = np.triu_indices(n, 1)
    while time.time() - start < seconds and radius > 1e-14:
        G = x @ x.T
        c_all = G[iu0]
        m = float(c_all.max())
        thr = m - max(20.0 * radius, 1e-9)
        sel = c_all > thr
        cnt = int(np.count_nonzero(sel))
        if cnt == 0:
            break
        if cnt > cap:
            v = c_all[sel]
            kth = np.sort(v)[-cap]
            sel = c_all >= kth
            cnt2 = int(np.count_nonzero(sel))
            if cnt2 > cap + 800:
                ids = np.where(sel)[0]
                keep = ids[::2][:cap]
                ns = np.zeros_like(sel)
                ns[keep] = True
                sel = ns
        I = iu0[0][sel]
        J = iu0[1][sel]
        c = c_all[sel]
        p = len(I)
        nv = n * d + 1
        rows = np.repeat(np.arange(p), 2 * d + 1)
        cd = np.arange(d)
        cols = np.concatenate([I[:, None] * d + cd, J[:, None] * d + cd,
                               np.full((p, 1), n * d)], 1).ravel()
        vals = np.concatenate([x[J], x[I], -np.ones((p, 1))], 1).ravel()
        A_ub = coo_matrix((vals, (rows, cols)), shape=(p, nv)).tocsr()
        A_eq = coo_matrix((x.ravel(), (np.repeat(np.arange(n), d),
                                       np.arange(n * d))), shape=(n, nv)).tocsr()
        obj = np.zeros(nv)
        obj[-1] = 1.0
        try:
            res = linprog(obj, A_ub=A_ub, b_ub=-c, A_eq=A_eq, b_eq=np.zeros(n),
                          bounds=[(-radius, radius)] * (n * d) + [(None, None)],
                          method="highs")
        except Exception:
            radius *= 0.5
            continue
        if res.status != 0:
            radius *= 0.5
            continue
        y = x + res.x[:-1].reshape(n, d)
        y /= np.linalg.norm(y, axis=1, keepdims=True)
        vv = _max_cos(y)
        if vv < best:
            x, best = y, vv
            radius = min(radius * 1.6, 0.05)
        else:
            radius *= 0.5
    return x

def _grow_track(rng, N0, t0, cutoff):
    x = _greedy_init(rng, N0)
    x = _adam_smooth(x, iters=500, T0=0.022, T1=0.0018, lr0=0.016, lr1=0.002)
    n = N0
    while n < 163:
        if time.time() - t0 > cutoff:
            break
        v = _best_void(x, rng)
        x = np.vstack([x, v.reshape(1, 4)])
        x /= np.linalg.norm(x, axis=1, keepdims=True)
        # polish after insertion, shorter as n grows
        x = _adam_smooth(x, iters=280, T0=0.016, T1=0.0015, lr0=0.012, lr1=0.0015)
        n += 1
    # final tune at 163
    if x.shape[0] == 163 and time.time() - t0 < cutoff:
        x = _adam_smooth(x, iters=250, T0=0.010, T1=0.0012, lr0=0.008, lr1=0.001)
    return x

def _shrink_track(rng, N1, t0, cutoff):
    z = rng.normal(size=(N1, 4))
    z /= np.linalg.norm(z, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    z = _adam_smooth(z, iters=550, T0=0.022, T1=0.0018, lr0=0.016, lr1=0.002)
    while z.shape[0] > 163:
        if time.time() - t0 > cutoff:
            break
        idx = _delete_choice(z)
        z = np.delete(z, idx, axis=0)
        z = _adam_smooth(z, iters=280, T0=0.016, T1=0.0015, lr0=0.012, lr1=0.0015)
    if z.shape[0] == 163 and time.time() - t0 < cutoff:
        z = _adam_smooth(z, iters=250, T0=0.010, T1=0.0012, lr0=0.008, lr1=0.001)
    return z

def solve():
    t0 = time.time()
    HARD = 165.0
    # homotopy must finish early to leave 15s for LP
    def time_left():
        return HARD - (time.time() - t0)
    # load fallback record
    fb = None
    fb_val = 1e9
    for fn in ("best.npy", "record.npy"):
        try:
            c = np.load(fn)
            c = np.asarray(c, dtype=float)
            if c.shape == (163, 4):
                c = c / np.linalg.norm(c, axis=1, keepdims=True)
                v = _max_cos(c)
                if v < fb_val:
                    fb_val = v
                    fb = c.copy()
        except Exception:
            continue
    if fb is None:
        rng0 = np.random.default_rng(0)
        fb = rng0.normal(size=(163, 4))
        fb /= np.linalg.norm(fb, axis=1, keepdims=True)
        fb_val = _max_cos(fb)

    homo_cutoff = 148.0  # seconds after t0 to stop homotopy
    best_h = None
    best_h_val = 1e9
    # independent seeds: 3 grow + 3 shrink
    grow_N0 = [150, 154, 157]
    shrink_N1 = [168, 172, 176]
    # interleave tracks
    plan = [("g", grow_N0[0], 101), ("s", shrink_N1[0], 201),
            ("g", grow_N0[1], 102), ("s", shrink_N1[1], 202),
            ("g", grow_N0[2], 103), ("s", shrink_N1[2], 203)]
    for kind, N, seed in plan:
        elapsed = time.time() - t0
        if elapsed > homo_cutoff:
            break
        if time_left() < 20:
            break
        rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
        try:
            if kind == "g":
                x = _grow_track(rng, N, t0, homo_cutoff)
            else:
                x = _shrink_track(rng, N, t0, homo_cutoff)
        except Exception:
            continue
        if x is None or x.shape != (163, 4):
            continue
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(x)):
            continue
        x = x / np.linalg.norm(x, axis=1, keepdims=True)
        v = _max_cos(x)
        if v < best_h_val:
            best_h_val = v
            best_h = x.copy()

    # reserve final 15 seconds for LP polishing
    elapsed = time.time() - t0
    lp_budget = min(15.0, max(0.5, HARD - elapsed - 0.5))
    if best_h is not None and time_left() > 1.0:
        try:
            best_h = _lp_polish(best_h, seconds=lp_budget)
            best_h = best_h / np.linalg.norm(best_h, axis=1, keepdims=True)
            best_h_val = _max_cos(best_h)
        except Exception:
            pass

    # fallback if no homotopy beats record
    if best_h is None or not np.all(np.isfinite(best_h)) or best_h_val >= fb_val:
        out = fb.copy()
    else:
        out = best_h.copy()
    out = out / np.linalg.norm(out, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    out = np.nan_to_num(out)
    out /= np.linalg.norm(out, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    return out

import time
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import linprog
from scipy.sparse import coo_matrix

_IU = None

def _norm(x):
    x = x / np.linalg.norm(x, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    return x

def _max_cos(x):
    g = x @ x.T
    np.fill_diagonal(g, -2.0)
    return float(np.max(g))

def _top_pairs(c_all, cap):
    n = c_all.shape[0]
    if n <= cap:
        return np.arange(n)
    # indices of largest cap
    part = np.argpartition(-c_all, cap - 1)[:cap]
    return part

def _build_lp(x, sel_idx, iu, radius):
    n, d = x.shape
    I = iu[0][sel_idx]
    J = iu[1][sel_idx]
    c = (x @ x.T)[I, J] if False else None
    return I, J

def _lp_polish(x, seconds, r0=2e-3, cap=1500):
    global _IU
    x = _norm(x)
    n, d = x.shape
    if _IU is None:
        _IU = np.triu_indices(n, 1)
    iu = _IU
    best = _max_cos(x)
    radius = r0
    start = time.time()
    iu0, iu1 = iu
    while time.time() - start < seconds and radius > 1e-13:
        G = x @ x.T
        c_all = G[iu0, iu1]
        m = float(c_all.max())
        thr = m - max(20.0 * radius, 1e-9)
        sel = np.where(c_all > thr)[0]
        cnt = sel.size
        if cnt == 0:
            break
        if cnt > cap:
            # keep largest cap
            v = c_all[sel]
            kth = np.sort(v)[-cap]
            sel = np.where(c_all >= kth)[0]
            if sel.size > cap + 400:
                sel = sel[::2][:cap]
        I = iu0[sel]; J = iu1[sel]
        c = c_all[sel]
        p = len(I)
        nv = n * d + 1
        rows = np.repeat(np.arange(p), 2 * d + 1)
        cd = np.arange(d)
        cols = np.concatenate([I[:, None] * d + cd, J[:, None] * d + cd,
                               np.full((p, 1), n * d)], 1).ravel()
        vals = np.concatenate([x[J], x[I], -np.ones((p, 1))], 1).ravel()
        A_ub = coo_matrix((vals, (rows, cols)), shape=(p, nv)).tocsr()
        A_eq = coo_matrix((x.ravel(), (np.repeat(np.arange(n), d),
                                       np.arange(n * d))), shape=(n, nv)).tocsr()
        obj = np.zeros(nv); obj[-1] = 1.0
        try:
            res = linprog(obj, A_ub=A_ub, b_ub=-c, A_eq=A_eq, b_eq=np.zeros(n),
                          bounds=[(-radius, radius)] * (n * d) + [(None, None)],
                          method="highs")
        except Exception:
            radius *= 0.5
            continue
        if res.status != 0:
            radius *= 0.5
            continue
        y = x + res.x[:-1].reshape(n, d)
        y = _norm(y)
        v = _max_cos(y)
        if v < best:
            x, best = y, v
            radius = min(radius * 1.6, 0.03)
        else:
            radius *= 0.5
    return x

def _smooth(x, iters, T0, T1, lr0, lr1):
    for k in range(iters):
        frac = k / max(iters - 1, 1)
        T = T0 * (T1 / T0) ** frac
        lr = lr0 * (lr1 / lr0) ** frac
        G = x @ x.T
        np.fill_diagonal(G, -2.0)
        m = float(G.max())
        W = np.exp((G - m) / T)
        np.fill_diagonal(W, 0.0)
        grad = W @ x
        dot = np.sum(grad * x, axis=1, keepdims=True)
        gt = grad - dot * x
        rs = W.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
        step = gt / np.maximum(rs, 1e-12)
        sn = np.linalg.norm(step, axis=1, keepdims=True)
        step = step / np.maximum(sn, 1.0)
        x = x - lr * step
        x = _norm(x)
    return x

def _dual_order(x, radius=2e-3, cap=1500):
    """Return (sel_I, sel_J, sel_c, order_by_stress). order indexes into sel arrays."""
    global _IU
    n, d = x.shape
    iu0, iu1 = _IU
    G = x @ x.T
    c_all = G[iu0, iu1]
    m = float(c_all.max())
    thr = m - max(20.0 * radius, 1e-9)

    cols = np.concatenate([I[:, None] * d + cd, J[:, None] * d + cd,
                           np.full((p, 1), n * d)], 1).ravel()
    vals = np.concatenate([x[J], x[I], -np.ones((p, 1))], 1).ravel()
    A_ub = coo_matrix((vals, (rows, cols)), shape=(p, nv)).tocsr()
    A_eq = coo_matrix((x.ravel(), (np.repeat(np.arange(n), d),
                                   np.arange(n * d))), shape=(n, nv)).tocsr()
    obj = np.zeros(nv); obj[-1] = 1.0
    try:
        res = linprog(obj, A_ub=A_ub, b_ub=-c, A_eq=A_eq, b_eq=np.zeros(n),
                      bounds=[(-radius, radius)] * (n * d) + [(None, None)],
                      method="highs")
    except Exception:
        order = np.argsort(-c)
        return I, J, c, order
    if res.status != 0:
        order = np.argsort(-c)
        return I, J, c, order
    try:
        marg = None
        if hasattr(res, 'ineqlin') and res.ineqlin is not None:
            iq = res.ineqlin
            if hasattr(iq, 'marginals'):
                marg = np.asarray(iq.marginals).ravel()
            elif isinstance(iq, dict) and 'marginals' in iq:
                marg = np.asarray(iq['marginals']).ravel()
            else:
                try:
                    marg = np.asarray(iq['marginals']).ravel()
                except Exception:
                    marg = None
        if marg is None:
            # try lowercase / alternative attr
            marg = np.asarray(getattr(res, 'marginals', None)).ravel()
    except Exception:
        marg = None
    if marg is None or marg.size != p:
        order = np.argsort(-c)
        return I, J, c, order
    stress = -marg  # positive for active
    order = np.argsort(-stress, kind='stable')
    return I, J, c, order

def _forced_run(x, force_I, force_J, target, seconds, r_init=0.012, cap=1200):
    """Constrained reopt: force pairs (force_I[k],force_J[k]) <= target, minimise max of rest."""
    global _IU
    x = _norm(x)
    n, d = x.shape
    iu0, iu1 = _IU

    fenc = set((int(a) * 1000 + int(b)) for a, b in zip(force_I, force_J))

    G0 = x @ x.T
    fc = G0[force_I, force_J] if len(force_I) > 0 else np.zeros(0)
    radius = r_init
    start = time.time()
    it = 0
    while time.time() - start < seconds and radius > 1e-12 and it < 12:
        it += 1
        G = x @ x.T
        c_all = G[iu0, iu1]
        m = float(c_all.max())
        # candidate pool: top cap by cosine
        if c_all.size > cap:
            sel = _top_pairs(c_all, cap)
        else:

        I = iu0[sel]; J = iu1[sel]
        c = c_all[sel]

        # rows 0..p-1 : xJ*dxI + xI*dxJ - t <= -c
        # rows p..p+f-1 : xJf*dxIf + xIf*dxJf <= target - fc_current
        # fc_current recomputed from current x
        if f > 0:
            Gf = G[force_I, force_J]
            rhs_f = target - Gf
        else:
            rhs_f = np.zeros(0)
        nv = n * d + 1
        # build sparse
        # first block
        rows1 = np.repeat(np.arange(p), 2 * d + 1)
        cd = np.arange(d)
        cols1 = np.concatenate([I[:, None] * d + cd, J[:, None] * d + cd,
                                np.full((p, 1), n * d)], 1).ravel()
        vals1 = np.concatenate([x[J], x[I], -np.ones((p, 1))], 1).ravel()
        if f > 0:
            rows2 = np.repeat(p + np.arange(f), 2 * d)
            cols2 = np.concatenate([np.asarray(force_I)[:, None] * d + cd,
                                    np.asarray(force_J)[:, None] * d + cd], 1).ravel()
            vals2 = np.concatenate([x[force_J], x[force_I]], 1).ravel()
            rows = np.concatenate([rows1, rows2])
            cols = np.concatenate([cols1, cols2])
            vals = np.concatenate([vals1, vals2])
            b_ub = np.concatenate([-c, rhs_f])
            nrows = p + f
        else:
            rows, cols, vals = rows1, cols1, vals1
            b_ub = -c

import time
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import linprog
from scipy.sparse import coo_matrix

def _max_cos(x):
    g = x @ x.T
    np.fill_diagonal(g, -2.0)
    return float(g.max())

def _lp_step(x, radius, cap=2200):
    n, d = x.shape
    iu = np.triu_indices(n, 1)
    G = x @ x.T
    c_all = G[iu]
    m = float(c_all.max())
    thr = m - max(20.0*radius, 1e-9)
    sel = c_all > thr
    if int(np.count_nonzero(sel)) == 0:
        return x, m, None
    if int(np.count_nonzero(sel)) > cap:
        v = c_all[sel]
        kth = np.sort(v)[-cap]
        sel = c_all >= kth
        if int(np.count_nonzero(sel)) > cap+800:
            ids = np.where(sel)[0][::2][:cap]
            ns = np.zeros_like(sel); ns[ids]=True; sel=ns
    I = iu[0][sel]; J = iu[1][sel]; c = c_all[sel]
    p = len(I); nv = n*d+1
    rows = np.repeat(np.arange(p), 2*d+1)
    cd = np.arange(d)
    cols = np.concatenate([I[:,None]*d+cd, J[:,None]*d+cd, np.full((p,1),n*d)],1).ravel()
    vals = np.concatenate([x[J], x[I], -np.ones((p,1))],1).ravel()
    A_ub = coo_matrix((vals,(rows,cols)),shape=(p,nv)).tocsr()
    A_eq = coo_matrix((x.ravel(),(np.repeat(np.arange(n),d),np.arange(n*d))),shape=(n,nv)).tocsr()
    obj = np.zeros(nv); obj[-1]=1.0
    try:
        res = linprog(obj,A_ub=A_ub,b_ub=-c,A_eq=A_eq,b_eq=np.zeros(n),
                      bounds=[(-radius,radius)]*(n*d)+[(None,None)],method="highs")
    except Exception:
        return x, m, None
    if res.status!=0:
        return x, m, res
    y = x + res.x[:-1].reshape(n,d)
    y /= np.linalg.norm(y,axis=1,keepdims=True)
    return y, _max_cos(y), res

def _smooth(x, iters, T0, T1, lr0, lr1):
    for k in range(iters):
        frac=k/max(iters-1,1)
        T=T0*(T1/T0)**frac; lr=lr0*(lr1/lr0)**frac
        G=x@x.T; np.fill_diagonal(G,-2.0); m=float(G.max())
        W=np.exp((G-m)/T); np.fill_diagonal(W,0.0)
        grad=W@x
        gt=grad-np.sum(grad*x,axis=1,keepdims=True)*x
        rs=W.sum(axis=1,keepdims=True)
        step=gt/np.maximum(rs,1e-12)
        sn=np.linalg.norm(step,axis=1,keepdims=True)
        step=step/np.maximum(sn,1.0)
        x=x-lr*step
        x/=np.linalg.norm(x,axis=1,keepdims=True)
    return x

import time
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import linprog
from scipy.sparse import coo_matrix

def _max_cos(x):
    g = x @ x.T
    np.fill_diagonal(g, -2.0)
    return float(np.max(g))

def _row_maxs(x):
    g = x @ x.T
    np.fill_diagonal(g, -2.0)
    return g.max(axis=1), g

def _lp_polish(x, seconds, r0=2e-3, cap=2000, max_it=12):
    x = x / np.linalg.norm(x, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    n, d = x.shape
    best = _max_cos(x)
    radius = r0
    start = time.time()
    iu0 = np.triu_indices(n, 1)
    it = 0
    while time.time() - start < seconds and radius > 1e-13 and it < max_it:
        it += 1
        G = x @ x.T
        c_all = G[iu0]
        m = float(c_all.max())
        thr = m - max(20.0 * radius, 1e-9)
        sel = c_all > thr
        cnt = int(np.count_nonzero(sel))
        if cnt == 0:
            break
        if cnt > cap:
            v = c_all[sel]
            kth = np.sort(v)[-cap]
            sel = c_all >= kth
            cnt2 = int(np.count_nonzero(sel))
            if cnt2 > cap + 600:
                ids = np.where(sel)[0]
                keep = ids[::2][:cap]
                ns = np.zeros_like(sel)
                ns[keep] = True
                sel = ns
        I = iu0[0][sel]; J = iu0[1][sel]
        c = c_all[sel]
        p = len(I)
        nv = n * d + 1
        rows = np.repeat(np.arange(p), 2 * d + 1)
        cd = np.arange(d)
        cols = np.concatenate([I[:, None]*d+cd, J[:, None]*d+cd, np.full((p,1), n*d)], 1).ravel()
        vals = np.concatenate([x[J], x[I], -np.ones((p,1))], 1).ravel()
        A_ub = coo_matrix((vals, (rows, cols)), shape=(p, nv)).tocsr()
        A_eq = coo_matrix((x.ravel(), (np.repeat(np.arange(n), d), np.arange(n*d))), shape=(n, nv)).tocsr()
        obj = np.zeros(nv); obj[-1] = 1.0
        try:
            res = linprog(obj, A_ub=A_ub, b_ub=-c, A_eq=A_eq, b_eq=np.zeros(n),
                          bounds=[(-radius, radius)]*(n*d)+[(None,None)], method="highs")
        except Exception:
            radius *= 0.5
            continue
        if res.status != 0:
            radius *= 0.5
            continue
        y = x + res.x[:-1].reshape(n, d)
        y /= np.linalg.norm(y, axis=1, keepdims=True)
        v = _max_cos(y)
        if v < best:
            x, best = y, v
            radius = min(radius*1.6, 0.04)
        else:
            radius *= 0.5
    return x

def _smooth(x, iters, T0, T1, lr0, lr1):
    n, d = x.shape
    for k in range(iters):
        frac = k / max(iters-1, 1)
        T = T0 * (T1/T0)**frac
        lr = lr0 * (lr1/lr0)**frac
        G = x @ x.T
        np.fill_diagonal(G, -2.0)
        m = float(G.max())
        W = np.exp((G-m)/T)
        np.fill_diagonal(W, 0.0)
        grad = W @ x
        dot = np.sum(grad*x, axis=1, keepdims=True)
        gt = grad - dot*x
        rs = W.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
        step = gt/np.maximum(rs, 1e-12)
        sn = np.linalg.norm(step, axis=1, keepdims=True)
        step = step/np.maximum(sn, 1.0)
        x = x - lr*step
        x /= np.linalg.norm(x, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    return x

def _voids(base, k, rng, n_samp=2200):
    cand = rng.normal(size=(n_samp, 4))
    cand /= np.linalg.norm(cand, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    s = cand @ base.T
    sc = s.max(axis=1)
    order = np.argsort(sc)[:max(k*6, k+6)]
    pool = cand[order].copy()
    # refine pool away from base
    for j in range(pool.shape[0]):
        v = pool[j]
        for _ in range(20):
            d1 = base @ v
            mx = d1.max()
            w = np.exp(40.0*(d1-mx))
            g = w @ base
            gt = g - np.dot(g, v)*v
            nrm = np.linalg.norm(gt)
            if nrm < 1e-12:
                break
            v = v - 0.10*gt/nrm
            v /= np.linalg.norm(v)
        pool[j] = v
    scores = (pool @ base.T).max(axis=1)
    idx = np.argsort(scores)
    pool = pool[idx]; scores = scores[idx]
    sel = []
    rem = list(range(pool.shape[0]))
    if rem:
        sel.append(rem.pop(0))
        while len(sel) < k and rem:
            S = pool[sel] @ pool[rem].T
            mm = S.max(axis=0)
            crit = scores[rem] + 0.3*mm
            j = int(np.argmin(crit))
            sel.append(rem.pop(j))
    return pool[np.array(sel)]

def solve():

            target=[]

import time
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import linprog
from scipy.sparse import coo_matrix

def _norm(x):
    n = np.linalg.norm(x, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    n = np.maximum(n, 1e-12)
    return x / n

def _max_cos(x):
    g = x @ x.T
    np.fill_diagonal(g, -2.0)
    return float(np.max(g))

def _lp_polish(x, seconds, r0=2e-3, cap=1300):
    x = _norm(x)
    n, d = x.shape
    best = _max_cos(x)
    iu0, iu1 = np.triu_indices(n, 1)
    cd = np.arange(d)
    radius = r0
    start = time.time()
    while time.time() - start < seconds and radius > 1e-13:
        # time guard per iteration
        G = x @ x.T
        c_all = G[iu0, iu1]
        m = float(c_all.max())
        thr = m - max(20.0 * radius, 1e-9)
        sel = np.where(c_all > thr)[0]
        if sel.size == 0:
            break
        if sel.size > cap:
            v = c_all[sel]
            kth = np.sort(v)[-cap]
            sel = np.where(c_all >= kth)[0]
            if sel.size > cap + 300:
                sel = sel[::2][:cap]
        I = iu0[sel]; J = iu1[sel]
        c = c_all[sel]
        p = len(I)
        nv = n * d + 1
        rows = np.repeat(np.arange(p), 2 * d + 1)
        cols = np.concatenate([I[:, None] * d + cd, J[:, None] * d + cd,
                               np.full((p, 1), n * d)], 1).ravel()
        vals = np.concatenate([x[J], x[I], -np.ones((p, 1))], 1).ravel()
        A_ub = coo_matrix((vals, (rows, cols)), shape=(p, nv)).tocsr()
        A_eq = coo_matrix((x.ravel(), (np.repeat(np.arange(n), d),
                                       np.arange(n * d))), shape=(n, nv)).tocsr()
        obj = np.zeros(nv); obj[-1] = 1.0
        try:
            res = linprog(obj, A_ub=A_ub, b_ub=-c, A_eq=A_eq, b_eq=np.zeros(n),
                          bounds=[(-radius, radius)] * (n * d) + [(None, None)],
                          method="highs")
        except Exception:
            radius *= 0.5
            continue
        if res.status != 0:
            radius *= 0.5
            continue
        y = x + res.x[:-1].reshape(n, d)
        y = _norm(y)
        v = _max_cos(y)
        if v < best:
            x, best = y, v
            radius = min(radius * 1.6, 0.02)
        else:
            radius *= 0.5
    return x

def _tangent_bases(x):
    n, d = x.shape
    assert d == 4
    T = np.empty((n, 4, 3))
    E = np.eye(4)
    for i in range(n):
        xi = x[i]
        m = int(np.argmax(np.abs(xi)))
        cols = [k for k in range(4) if k != m]
        M = np.stack([E[:, k] - xi[k] * xi for k in cols], axis=1)  # 4x3
        Q, _ = np.linalg.qr(M)
        T[i] = Q
    return T

def _rotation_modes(T, x):
    n = x.shape[0]
    N = n * 3
    R = []
    for a in range(4):
        for b in range(a + 1, 4):
            A = np.zeros((4, 4))
            A[a, b] = 1.0
            A[b, a] = -1.0
            # dx_i = A x_i
            V = np.empty(N)
            for i in range(n):
                dxi = A @ x[i]
                V[i * 3:(i + 1) * 3] = T[i].T @ dxi
            R.append(V)
    R = np.stack(R, axis=1)  # N x 6
    Q, _ = np.linalg.qr(R)
    return Q  # N x 6 orthonormal

def _build_rigidity(x, T, I, J):
    p = len(I)
    n = x.shape[0]
    N = n * 3
    Rmat = np.empty((p, N))
    # precompute T^T x for speed? loop is fine (p~500)
    for r in range(p):
        a = int(I[r]); b = int(J[r])
        ca = T[a].T @ x[b]
        cb = T[b].T @ x[a]
        row = np.zeros(N)
        row[a * 3:(a + 1) * 3] = ca
        row[b * 3:(b + 1) * 3] = cb
        Rmat[r] = row
    return Rmat

def solve():
    rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
    t0 = time.time()
    HARD = 168.0
    FINAL_RESERVE = 20.0

    n, d = 163, 4
    xb = None; xr = None
    try:

    except Exception:

        xr = None
    cands = []
    for c in (xb, xr):
        try:
            if c is not None:
                c = np.asarray(c, dtype=float)
                if c.shape == (163, 4):
                    c = _norm(np.nan_to_num(c, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0))
                    # guard zero rows
                    nr = np.linalg.norm(c, axis=1)
                    if np.all(nr > 1e-9) and np.all(np.isfinite(c)):

        except Exception:

        cands.append(_norm(z))
    best = None; best_val = 1e9

        v = _max_cos(c)
        if v < best_val:

    incumbent = best.copy()
    incumbent_val = best_val

    iu0, iu1 = np.triu_indices(n, 1)

    def contact_info(x):
        G = x @ x.T
        np.fill_diagonal(G, -2.0)
        m = float(G.max())
        c_all = G[iu0, iu1]
        slack = m - c_all
        sel9 = np.where(slack < 1e-9)[0]
        # second shell: slack in [1e-9, 3e-3] roughly, use for exchange detection
        return m, c_all, slack, sel9

    # build nullspace pool from incumbent/best
    def null_pool(x):
        m, c_all, slack, sel9 = contact_info(x)
        I = iu0[sel9]; J = iu1[sel9]
        # fallback thresholds if too few contacts
        if len(I) < 50:
            sel7 = np.where(slack < 1e-7)[0]
            I = iu0[sel7]; J = iu1[sel7]
        if len(I) < 10:
            # take top 400
            o = np.argsort(slack)[:400]
            I = iu0[o]; J = iu1[o]
        T = _tangent_bases(x)
        Rmat = _build_rigidity(x, T, I, J)
        Qr = _rotation_modes(T, x)

            # Vt shape N x N

        Vb = Vt[N - K:N, :].T.copy()  # N x K
        # project out rotations
        # Vb - Qr(Qr^T Vb)
        coeff = Qr.T @ Vb  # 6 x K
        Vb = Vb - Qr @ coeff
        # renormalize, drop tiny
        norms = np.linalg.norm(Vb, axis=0, keepdims=True)
        norms = np.maximum(norms, 1e-12)
        Vb = Vb / norms
        # drop modes that were mostly rotation (original norm after proj small)
        # recompute raw norm factor: we already normalized; instead check projection energy
        # keep all, random combos will average out
        return Vb, T, Qr, m, sel9, I, J

    Vb, Tcur, Qr, mcur, sel9_cur, Ic, Jc = null_pool(best)
    if Vb is None:
        # fallback: just polish
        rem = HARD - (time.time() - t0)
        rem = max(rem - 2.0, 2.0)
        best = _lp_polish(best, seconds=min(rem, 25.0))
        return _norm(best)

    active_set = set(sel9_cur.tolist())
    K = Vb.shape[1]
    # precompute direction scale helper
    ALPHAS = np.array([0.004, 0.008, 0.015, 0.025, 0.04, 0.06, 0.09])

    n_modes = 32
    for mode in range(n_modes):
        elapsed = time.time() - t0
        if elapsed > HARD - FINAL_RESERVE - 3.0:
            break
        # sample random combo of near-null modes
        w = rng.normal(size=K)
        # emphasize smallest singular directions: weight last modes more
        # Vb columns ordered? Vt bottom rows: last row is most null. Our Vb columns 0..K-1 correspond to increasing nullity.
        # boost latter half
        boost = np.linspace(0.5, 1.5, K)
        w = w * boost
        w /= max(np.linalg.norm(w), 1e-12)
        v = Vb @ w  # N
        # map to 3D displacements
        Y = v.reshape(n, 3)
        D = np.empty((n, 4))

import time
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import linprog
from scipy.sparse import coo_matrix

def _max_cos(x):
    g = x @ x.T
    np.fill_diagonal(g, -2.0)
    return float(np.max(g))

def _smooth_full(x, iters, T0, T1, lr0, lr1):
    n, d = x.shape
    for k in range(iters):
        frac = k / max(iters - 1, 1)
        T = T0 * (T1 / T0) ** frac
        lr = lr0 * (lr1 / lr0) ** frac
        G = x @ x.T
        np.fill_diagonal(G, -2.0)
        m = float(G.max())
        W = np.exp((G - m) / T)
        np.fill_diagonal(W, 0.0)
        grad = W @ x
        dot = np.sum(grad * x, axis=1, keepdims=True)
        gt = grad - dot * x
        rs = W.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
        step = gt / np.maximum(rs, 1e-12)
        sn = np.linalg.norm(step, axis=1, keepdims=True)
        step = step / np.maximum(sn, 1.0)
        x = x - lr * step
        x /= np.linalg.norm(x, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    return x

_IU = None
def _lp_polish(x, seconds, r0=2e-3, cap=1500):
    global _IU
    x = x / np.linalg.norm(x, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    n, d = x.shape
    if _IU is None or _IU[0].shape[0] != n * (n - 1) // 2:
        _IU = np.triu_indices(n, 1)
    iu = _IU
    best = _max_cos(x)
    radius = r0
    start = time.time()
    while time.time() - start < seconds and radius > 1e-13:
        G = x @ x.T
        c_all = G[iu]
        m = float(c_all.max())
        thr = m - max(20.0 * radius, 1e-9)
        sel = c_all > thr
        cnt = int(np.count_nonzero(sel))
        if cnt == 0:
            break
        if cnt > cap:
            v = c_all[sel]
            kth = np.sort(v)[-cap]
            sel = c_all >= kth
            cnt2 = int(np.count_nonzero(sel))
            if cnt2 > cap + 400:
                ids = np.where(sel)[0]
                keep = ids[::2][:cap]
                ns = np.zeros_like(sel)
                ns[keep] = True
                sel = ns
        I = iu[0][sel]
        J = iu[1][sel]
        c = c_all[sel]
        p = len(I)
        nv = n * d + 1
        rows = np.repeat(np.arange(p), 2 * d + 1)
        cd = np.arange(d)
        cols = np.concatenate([I[:, None] * d + cd, J[:, None] * d + cd,
                               np.full((p, 1), n * d)], 1).ravel()
        vals = np.concatenate([x[J], x[I], -np.ones((p, 1))], 1).ravel()
        A_ub = coo_matrix((vals, (rows, cols)), shape=(p, nv)).tocsr()
        A_eq = coo_matrix((x.ravel(), (np.repeat(np.arange(n), d),
                                       np.arange(n * d))), shape=(n, nv)).tocsr()
        obj = np.zeros(nv)
        obj[-1] = 1.0
        try:
            res = linprog(obj, A_ub=A_ub, b_ub=-c, A_eq=A_eq, b_eq=np.zeros(n),
                          bounds=[(-radius, radius)] * (n * d) + [(None, None)],
                          method="highs")
        except Exception:
            radius *= 0.5
            continue
        if res.status != 0:
            radius *= 0.5
            continue
        y = x + res.x[:-1].reshape(n, d)
        y /= np.linalg.norm(y, axis=1, keepdims=True)
        v = _max_cos(y)
        if v < best:
            x, best = y, v
            radius = min(radius * 1.6, 0.03)
        else:
            radius *= 0.5
    return x

def _expand_SP(Y, F, m):
    # Y (q,4), F (nf,4) or None -> X (nf+q*m,4)
    if Y is None or len(Y) == 0:
        return F.copy()
    q = Y.shape[0]
    c = np.cos(2.0 * np.pi * np.arange(m) / m)
    s = np.sin(2.0 * np.pi * np.arange(m) / m)
    Y1 = Y[:, 0:1]
    Y2 = Y[:, 1:2]
    Y3 = Y[:, 2:3]
    Y4 = Y[:, 3:4]
    Xo0 = Y1 * c[None, :] - Y2 * s[None, :]
    Xo1 = Y1 * s[None, :] + Y2 * c[None, :]
    Xo2 = np.broadcast_to(Y3, (q, m))
    Xo3 = np.broadcast_to(Y4, (q, m))
    Xo = np.stack([Xo0, Xo1, Xo2, Xo3], axis=2).reshape(q * m, 4)
    if F is not None and len(F) > 0:
        return np.concatenate([F, Xo], axis=0)
    return Xo

def _sym_smooth(Y0, F0, m, iters, T0, T1, lr0, lr1, pin_first=True):
    q = Y0.shape[0]
    Y = Y0 / np.linalg.norm(Y0, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    if F0 is not None and len(F0) > 0:
        F = F0 / np.linalg.norm(F0, axis=1, keepdims=True)
        F[:, 0:2] = 0.0
        F /= np.linalg.norm(F, axis=1, keepdims=True)
        nf = F.shape[0]
    else:
        F = None
        nf = 0
    c = np.cos(2.0 * np.pi * np.arange(m) / m)
    s = np.sin(2.0 * np.pi * np.arange(m) / m)
    for k in range(iters):
        frac = k / max(iters - 1, 1)
        T = T0 * (T1 / T0) ** frac
        lr = lr0 * (lr1 / lr0) ** frac
        X = _expand_SP(Y, F, m)
        N = X.shape[0]
        G = X @ X.T
        np.fill_diagonal(G, -2.0)
        mv = float(G.max())
        W = np.exp((G - mv) / T)
        np.fill_diagonal(W, 0.0)
        grad = W @ X
        dot = np.sum(grad * X, axis=1, keepdims=True)
        gt = grad - dot * X
        rs = W.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
        stepX = gt / np.maximum(rs, 1e-12)
        sn = np.linalg.norm(stepX, axis=1, keepdims=True)
        stepX = stepX / np.maximum(sn, 1.0)
        # fold orbit part
        S = stepX[nf:].reshape(q, m, 4)
        g0 = S[:, :, 0]
        g1 = S[:, :, 1]
        gr0 = g0 * c[None, :] + g1 * s[None, :]
        gr1 = -g0 * s[None, :] + g1 * c[None, :]
        gr2 = S[:, :, 2]
        gr3 = S[:, :, 3]
        mean = np.stack([gr0.mean(axis=1), gr1.mean(axis=1),
                         gr2.mean(axis=1), gr3.mean(axis=1)], axis=1)
        dY = np.sum(mean * Y, axis=1, keepdims=True)
        mt = mean - dY * Y
        nm = np.linalg.norm(mt, axis=1, keepdims=True) + 1e-12
        Y = Y - lr * (mt / nm)
        Y /= np.linalg.norm(Y, axis=1, keepdims=True)
        # fixed points (keep first pinned to fix gauge)
        if F is not None and nf > 0:
            sF = stepX[:nf].copy()
            sF[:, 0:2] = 0.0
            dF = np.sum(sF * F, axis=1, keepdims=True)
            mtF = sF - dF * F
            mtF[:, 0:2] = 0.0
            nmF = np.linalg.norm(mtF, axis=1, keepdims=True) + 1e-12
            upd = lr * (mtF / nmF)
            if pin_first and nf >= 1:
                upd[0, :] = 0.0
            F = F - upd
            F[:, 0:2] = 0.0
            F /= np.linalg.norm(F, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    return Y, F

def solve():
    rng = np.random.default_rng(12345)
    t0 = time.time()
    HARD = 168.0

        gt = grad - dot * x
        rs = W.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
        step = gt / np.maximum(rs, 1e-12)
        sn = np.linalg.norm(step, axis=1, keepdims=True)
        # cap step norm to 1
        step = step / np.maximum(sn, 1.0)
        x = x - lr * step
        x /= np.linalg.norm(x, axis=1, keepdims=True)

def _refine_voids(base, pool, steps=35, lr=0.07, sharp=70.0):
    out = np.empty_like(pool)
    for i in range(pool.shape[0]):
        v = pool[i].copy()
        for _ in range(steps):
            d = base @ v
            dm = float(d.max())
            w = np.exp(sharp * (d - dm))
            s = float(w.sum())
            if s == 0:
                break
            g = (w @ base) / s
            gt = g - np.dot(g, v) * v
            nrm = float(np.linalg.norm(gt))
            if nrm < 1e-12:
                break
            v = v - lr * gt / nrm
            n = float(np.linalg.norm(v))
            if n == 0:
                break
            v /= n
        out[i] = v
    return out

def _find_voids(base, rng, k, n_samp=8000):

            ratt = np.where(deg <= 1)[0]
            victims = []
            victims.append(int(worst_order[-1]))
            for rr in ratt:
                if int(rr) not in victims and len(victims) < nk:
                    victims.append(int(rr))
            pool_w = list(worst_order[-10:])
            rng.shuffle(pool_w)
            for c in pool_w:
                if len(victims) >= nk:
                    break
                if int(c) not in victims:
                    victims.append(int(c))
            victims = np.array(victims[:nk], dtype=int)
            keep_mask = np.ones(n, dtype=bool)
            keep_mask[victims] = False
            keep_idx = np.where(keep_mask)[0]
            base = x[keep_idx]
            voids = _find_voids(base, rng, len(victims), n_samp=7000)
            voids = voids + rng.normal(scale=8e-4, size=voids.shape)
            voids /= np.linalg.norm(voids, axis=1, keepdims=True)
            x[victims] = voids
            sig = 0.009 * (1.0 - frac) + 0.002
            x[keep_idx] = x[keep_idx] + rng.normal(scale=sig, size=(len(keep_idx), 4))
            x /= np.linalg.norm(x, axis=1, keepdims=True)
        elif mode == 2:
            # cluster kill: densest point + nearest neighbours
            w0 = int(worst_order[-1])
            d0 = (x @ x[w0])
            nbr = np.argsort(-d0)[:5]
            keep_mask = np.ones(n, dtype=bool)
            keep_mask[nbr] = False
            keep_idx = np.where(keep_mask)[0]
            base = x[keep_idx]
            voids = _find_voids(base, rng, len(nbr), n_samp=7000)
            voids = voids + rng.normal(scale=1e-3, size=voids.shape)
            voids /= np.linalg.norm(voids, axis=1, keepdims=True)
            x[nbr] = voids

            x[keep_idx] = x[keep_idx] + rng.normal(scale=sig, size=(len(keep_idx), 4))

        else:

            d0 = (x @ x[w0])

            sig = 0.055 * (1.0 - frac) + 0.010
            x[nbr] = x[nbr] + rng.normal(scale=sig, size=(len(nbr), 4))

        T0 = 0.028 if (it % 2 == 0) else 0.014
        T1 = 0.0018
        lr0, lr1 = 0.065, 0.012
        # fewer iters for large kicks, more for small

        v = _max_cos(x)
        tol = 0.0018 * (1.0 - frac)
        if v < cur + tol:

        if v < best:

        if best < 0.8540:
            break
        if DEAD - (time.time() - t0) < 58:

    remain = DEAD - (time.time() - t0)
    lp_time = float(min(42.0, max(8.0, remain - 4.0)))
    if lp_time > 3 and DEAD - (time.time() - t0) > 6:

        best = _max_cos(x_best)
    # micro shake screen at basin edge

            y = x_best + rng.normal(scale=0.0028, size=x_best.shape)
            y /= np.linalg.norm(y, axis=1, keepdims=True)

        if r2 > 2:

    x_best /= np.linalg.norm(x_best, axis=1, keepdims=True)

direction: Perform dual-guided contact-graph surgery rather than random shaking: solve the final trust-region LP at the record, extract its dual variables or marginals for the active pairs, and identify the most stressed contacts and points, then run a constrained reoptimization in which 20–40 selected active pairs are forced to have cosine at most $\text{current max}-\delta$ for $\delta\in[5\times10^{-4},2\times10^{-3}]$, temporarily accepting an increase in other pairs before removing the forcing terms and LP-polishing. Repeat with different stressed clusters—highest-dual edges, high-degree points, and spatially localized patches—and keep candidates whose contact graph at a $10^{-5}$ threshold differs substantially, since a genuinely new topology is more promising than another nearly identical local optimum.

import time
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import linprog
from scipy.sparse import coo_matrix

_IU = None

def _max_cos(x):
    g = x @ x.T
    np.fill_diagonal(g, -2.0)
    return float(g.max())

def _iu(n):
    global _IU
    if _IU is None or _IU[0].shape[0] != n*(n-1)//2:
        _IU = np.triu_indices(n, 1)
    return _IU

def _lp_polish(x, seconds, t_deadline=None, r0=2e-3, cap=2500):
    x = x / np.linalg.norm(x, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    n, d = x.shape
    iu = _iu(n)
    best = _max_cos(x)
    radius = r0
    start = time.time()
    it = 0
    while True:
        if time.time() - start >= seconds:
            break
        if t_deadline is not None and time.time() >= t_deadline:
            break
        if radius < 1e-14 or it >= 150:
            break
        it += 1
        G = x @ x.T
        c_all = G[iu]
        m = float(c_all.max())
        thr = m - max(20.0*radius, 1e-9)
        sel = c_all > thr
        if int(np.count_nonzero(sel)) == 0:
            break
        if int(np.count_nonzero(sel)) > cap:
            v = c_all[sel]
            kth = np.sort(v)[-cap]
            sel = c_all >= kth
            if int(np.count_nonzero(sel)) > cap+800:
                ids = np.where(sel)[0][::2][:cap]
                ns = np.zeros_like(sel)
                ns[ids] = True
                sel = ns
        I = iu[0][sel]; J = iu[1][sel]
        c = c_all[sel]
        p = len(I)
        nv = n*d+1
        rows = np.repeat(np.arange(p), 2*d+1)
        cd = np.arange(d)
        cols = np.concatenate([I[:,None]*d+cd, J[:,None]*d+cd, np.full((p,1),n*d)],1).ravel()
        vals = np.concatenate([x[J], x[I], -np.ones((p,1))],1).ravel()
        A_ub = coo_matrix((vals,(rows,cols)),shape=(p,nv)).tocsr()
        A_eq = coo_matrix((x.ravel(),(np.repeat(np.arange(n),d),np.arange(n*d))),shape=(n,nv)).tocsr()
        obj = np.zeros(nv); obj[-1]=1.0
        try:
            res = linprog(obj,A_ub=A_ub,b_ub=-c,A_eq=A_eq,b_eq=np.zeros(n),
                          bounds=[(-radius,radius)]*(n*d)+[(None,None)],method="highs")
        except Exception:
            radius*=0.5
            continue
        if res.status!=0:
            radius*=0.5
            continue
        y = x + res.x[:-1].reshape(n,d)
        y /= np.linalg.norm(y,axis=1,keepdims=True)
        v = _max_cos(y)
        if v < best:
            x, best = y, v
            radius = min(radius*1.6, 0.05)
        else:
            radius*=0.5
    return x

def _stress_from_duals(x, radius=1e-3):
    n,d = x.shape
    iu = _iu(n)
    G = x @ x.T
    c_all = G[iu]
    m = float(c_all.max())
    thr = m - max(20.0*radius, 2e-9)
    sel = c_all > thr
    I = iu[0][sel]; J = iu[1][sel]
    c = c_all[sel]
    p = len(I)
    nv = n*d+1
    rows = np.repeat(np.arange(p),2*d+1)
    cd = np.arange(d)
    cols = np.concatenate([I[:,None]*d+cd,J[:,None]*d+cd,np.full((p,1),n*d)],1).ravel()
    vals = np.concatenate([x[J],x[I],-np.ones((p,1))],1).ravel()
    A_ub = coo_matrix((vals,(rows,cols)),shape=(p,nv)).tocsr()
    A_eq = coo_matrix((x.ravel(),(np.repeat(np.arange(n),d),np.arange(n*d))),shape=(n,nv)).tocsr()
    obj = np.zeros(nv); obj[-1]=1.0
    try:
        res = linprog(obj,A_ub=A_ub,b_ub=-c,A_eq=A_eq,b_eq=np.zeros(n),
                      bounds=[(-radius,radius)]*(n*d)+[(None,None)],method="highs")
    except Exception:
        return None
    if res.status!=0:
        return None
    w = None
    try:
        mg = res.ineqlin.marginals
        mg = np.asarray(mg).ravel()
        if mg.shape[0]==p:
            w = -mg
    except Exception:
        try:
            mg = res.ineqlin["marginals"]
            mg = np.asarray(mg).ravel()
            if mg.shape[0]==p:
                w = -mg
        except Exception:
            w = None
    if w is None:
        return None
    w = np.maximum(w,0.0)
    if w.max()<=0:
        return None
    return (I,J,c,m,w)

def _contact_info(x, tight=1e-9):
    n = x.shape[0]
    iu = _iu(n)
    G = x @ x.T
    c_all = G[iu]
    m = float(c_all.max())
    sel = c_all >= m-tight
    deg = np.zeros(n)
    np.add.at(deg, iu[0][sel], 1)
    np.add.at(deg, iu[1][sel], 1)
    return m, deg, sel, c_all

def _edge_mask(x, thresh=1e-5):
    n = x.shape[0]
    iu = _iu(n)
    G = x @ x.T
    c_all = G[iu]
    m = float(c_all.max())
    return c_all >= m-thresh

def _forced_steps(x, IF, JF, m0, delta, steps=4, radius=0.018):
    n,d = x.shape
    iu = _iu(n)
    nv = n*d+1
    cd = np.arange(d)
    for _ in range(steps):
        G = x @ x.T
        c_all = G[iu]
        m_cur = float(c_all.max())
        thr = m_cur - max(20.0*radius, 1e-9)
        sel = c_all > thr
        # map forced out of normal set
        # build normal I,J excluding forced pairs (check via set for small F)
        fset = set(zip(IF.tolist(),JF.tolist()))
        Iall = iu[0][sel]; Jall = iu[1][sel]
        keep = np.array([ (a,b) not in fset for a,b in zip(Iall,Jall)], dtype=bool)
        IN = Iall[keep]; JN = Jall[keep]
        # cap normal
        if len(IN)>2200:
            cn = G[IN,JN]
            kth = np.sort(cn)[-2200]
            m2 = cn>=kth
            IN = IN[m2]; JN = JN[m2]
        cF = G[IF,JF]
        cN = G[IN,JN] if len(IN)>0 else np.zeros(0)
        pF = len(IF); pN = len(IN); p = pF+pN
        if p==0:
            break
        # rows: F rows have 0*t coef, N rows have -1
        rowsF = np.repeat(np.arange(pF),2*d) if pF>0 else np.zeros(0,dtype=int)
        rowsN = np.repeat(np.arange(pF,p),2*d+1) if pN>0 else np.zeros(0,dtype=int)
        cols_list=[]; vals_list=[]; rows_list=[]
        if pF>0:
            colsF = np.concatenate([IF[:,None]*d+cd, JF[:,None]*d+cd],1).ravel()
            valsF = np.concatenate([x[JF],x[IF]],1).ravel()
            cols_list.append(colsF); vals_list.append(valsF); rows_list.append(rowsF)
        if pN>0:
            colsN = np.concatenate([IN[:,None]*d+cd, JN[:,None]*d+cd, np.full((pN,1),n*d)],1).ravel()
            valsN = np.concatenate([x[JN],x[IN],-np.ones((pN,1))],1).ravel()
            cols_list.append(colsN); vals_list.append(valsN); rows_list.append(rowsN)
        import numpy as _np
        rows_all = _np.concatenate(rows_list) if rows_list else _np.zeros(0,dtype=int)
        cols_all = _np.concatenate(cols_list) if cols_list else _np.zeros(0,dtype=int)
        vals_all = _np.concatenate(vals_list) if vals_list else _np.zeros(0)
        A_ub = coo_matrix((vals_all,(rows_all,cols_all)),shape=(p,nv)).tocsr()
        b_ub = _np.concatenate([ (m0-delta-cF) if pF>0 else _np.zeros(0), -cN ]) if p>0 else _np.zeros(0)
        A_eq = coo_matrix((x.ravel(),(np.repeat(np.arange(n),d),np.arange(n*d))),shape=(n,nv)).tocsr()
        obj = np.zeros(nv); obj[-1]=1.0
        try:
            res = linprog(obj,A_ub=A_ub,b_ub=b_ub,A_eq=A_eq,b_eq=np.zeros(n),
                          bounds=[(-radius,radius)]*(n*d)+[(None,None)],method="highs")
        except Exception:
            radius*=0.5
            continue
        if res.status!=0:
            # try larger radius once, else abort forcing
            if radius<0.04:
                radius*=1.8
                try:
                    res2 = linprog(obj,A_ub=A_ub,b_ub=b_ub,A_eq=A_eq,b_eq=np.zeros(n),
                                   bounds=[(-radius,radius)]*(n*d)+[(None,None)],method="highs")
                    if res2.status!=0:
                        break
                    res=res2
                except Exception:
                    break
            else:
                break
        y = x + res.x[:-1].reshape(n,d)
        y /= np.linalg.norm(y,axis=1,keepdims=True)
        x = y
    return x

def solve():
    t0=time.time()
    HARD_END=t0+172.0
    rng=np.random.default_rng(12345)
    best=None; best_val=1e9
    for fn in ("best.npy","record.npy"):
        try:
            a=np.load(fn).astype(float)
            if a.shape==(163,4):
                a/=np.linalg.norm(a,axis=1,keepdims=True)
                v=_max_cos(a)
                if v<best_val:
                    best_val=v; best=a.copy()
        except Exception:
            pass
    if best is None:
        best=rng.standard_normal(size=(163,4))
        best/=np.linalg.norm(best,axis=1,keepdims=True)
        best_val=_max_cos(best)
    n,d=best.shape
    iu=_iu(n)
    if HARD_END-time.time()>25:
        best=_lp_polish(best,seconds=3.0,t_deadline=HARD_END-8)
        best_val=_max_cos(best)
    best_mask=_edge_mask(best,1e-5)
    # initial stress
    dual=None
    try:
        dual=_stress_from_duals(best)
    except Exception:
        dual=None
    pool=[best.copy()]
    pool_vals=[best_val]
    pool_masks=[best_mask.copy()]
    trial=0
    deltas=[5e-4,8e-4,1.1e-3,1.5e-3,2e-3]
    while time.time()<HARD_END-12:
        trial+=1
        # refresh duals periodically from champion
        if trial%12==1 or dual is None:
            try:
                nd=_stress_from_duals(best)
                if nd is not None:
                    dual=nd
            except Exception:
                pass
            m0,deg,sel_tight,c_all=_contact_info(best,1e-9)
        else:
            m0,deg,sel_tight,c_all=_contact_info(best,1e-9)
        m0=float(best_val)
        # choose base: mostly champion, sometimes diverse pool
        if len(pool)>1 and trial%4==0:
            bi=int(rng.integers(0,len(pool)))
            base=pool[bi]
        else:
            base=best
        mode=trial%3
        IF=None; JF=None
        delta=deltas[(trial//3)%len(deltas)]
        try:
            if mode==0:
                # highest-dual edges
                if dual is not None:
                    I,J,c,mw,w=dual
                    # dual corresponds to old best; if base is not best, map by ranking c on base
                    if base is not best:
                        Gb=base@base.T; cb=Gb[iu]

                        # take top k with positive weight, pad if needed

                            if k==0:
                                raise ValueError("no dual")
                        take=pos[:k]
                        # ensure 20-40

                            extra=np.argsort(-c)
                            for e in extra:
                                if e not in set(take.tolist()):

                else:

                    k=30
                    take=order[:k]
                    IF=iu[0][take]; JF=iu[1][take]
            elif mode==1:

                order_pts=np.argsort(-deg)
                npick=3+(trial%3)  # 3-5
                pts=order_pts[:npick]
                inset=set(pts.tolist())
                Iall=iu[0][sel_tight]; Jall=iu[1][sel_tight]
                mask=np.array([(a in inset or b in inset) for a,b in zip(Iall,Jall)])
                candI=Iall[mask]; candJ=Jall[mask]
                if len(candI)<10 or len(candI)>45:
                    # if too many, keep highest c; if too few, add tightest
                    Gb=base@base.T; cb=Gb[iu]
                    if len(candI)>45:
                        cc=Gb[candI,candJ]
                        o=np.argsort(-cc)[:35]
                        candI=candI[o]; candJ=candJ[o]
                    else:

                Iall=iu[0][sel2]; Jall=iu[1][sel2]
                mask=np.array([(a in inset or b in inset) for a,b in zip(Iall,Jall)])
                candI=Iall[mask]; candJ=Jall[mask]
                if len(candI)<10 or len(candI)>45:
